messages:
oliver: Quick sync  compact dashboard chart in staging. At narrow widths legend wraps weirdly and axis unit text gets clipped. Screenshot: https://staging.redwood.app/snap/4999

maya: For small tiles I'd prefer a condensed legend: two-column, single-line items, with full names available to screen readers. Keeps height down.

devin: Could we also abbreviate axis units with SI suffixes (k, M) and show exact values in hover tooltips? Avoids label overflow.

sam: Minor gridlines are noisy at 1px; propose dropping opacity to 8% and only label 3 major ticks (min, median, max) on very small charts.

a11y-bot: accessibility-note: VoiceOver reads every tick label. Recommend an offscreen table and an aria summary instead of leaving all ticks live.

oliver: Outlier handling idea: cap axis at p99 and render overflow points in a separate "overflow band" with an "N outliers" pill that opens a keyboard-accessible modal showing full values.

maya: Love the overflow pill. For copy: pill text should be: "3 outliers  > 2.4s" maybe too long. Suggest: "3 outliers > 2.4s" and aria-label "3 outliers above 2.4 seconds, view details".

devin: Smoothing: default to raw line, provide optional smoothed overlay (toggle in legend) and show a subtle "Smoothed" badge when enabled. Prevent smoothing from affecting alerting thresholds.

sam: Also add micro-jitter for overlapping outlier dots and a faint halo so they're discoverable but don't resize the axis.

a11y-bot: check: ensure legend is `role=\"list\"` and items announced once. Also use `aria-live=\"polite\"` for overflow count changes only.

oliver: Next steps: devin to implement condensed legend + SI tick format, sam to prototype overflow band + modal, maya to draft microcopy and aria labels, I'll coordinate QA. Ship behind feature flag.
